name: InvaderZ
tagline: Space Invaders where every friend who joins gets another cannon.
description:
Send the invite and extra cannons appear on the same ground — each person aiming their own, everyone shooting the same wave.

On your own it is InvaderZ: the invaders change shape as you play. Each body is how it moves. Miss one and it teaches the next wave. You get one shot at a time. Five through the line and the sky is lost.

On a phone the buttons sit under the board — left, right, fire. On a computer it is the arrows (or A and D) and the space bar.

An unofficial port of InvaderZ by victorqribeiro, MIT-licensed. This copy adds the extra cannons over a meeting.
